spec.name: WIDEN_SHUF
spec.note: THE LAUNDERING CONTROL for WIDEN. Identical D, N, bytes and marginal statistics; the b3 rows are permuted so the block carries NO information about the row it sits beside. A WIDEN gain that survives here is not content.

grouping.mixing_note: 1.0 = every well holds the global block mixture; 0.0 = every well is a single block. A low value means the joint store is two stores side by side.

byte_ledger.note: ⭐ matched bytes with the codebook at N = M: the landscape gets NO extra points and must win on the EXPONENT alone (PREREG §2).
byte_ledger.what: 32 atoms x 4096 float32 = the store, content=['p', 'b3']
